# spaceout

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

My personal R coding style as a [`styler`](https://styler.r-lib.org/)-compatible package.

## Installation

You can install the released version of spaceout with any one of the following:

``` r
remotes::install_github("mpadge/spaceout")
remotes::install_git ("https://codeberg.org/mpadge/spaceout")
remotes::install_git ("https://codefloe.com/mpadge/spaceout")


```


## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r code}
code <- "say('hi'); list[[a[2]]]"
styler::style_text (code, style = spaceout::spaceout_style)
```
